name: Abraham
summary: First called Abram, he was the man God called to leave his homeland, promising to make him a great nation and to bless all families of the earth through him. He believed the LORD, and in his old age God gave him and Sarah a son, Isaac.

key_moments.title: Called to Leave Home
key_moments.description: The LORD told Abram to leave his country and his father's house for a land He would show him, and promised to bless him. Abram went, and in Canaan the LORD promised that land to his descendants.

key_moments.title: Counting the Stars
key_moments.description: The LORD took Abram outside and told him to count the stars, for his descendants would be as many. Abram believed the LORD, and the LORD credited it to him as righteousness.

key_moments.title: Three Visitors
key_moments.description: The LORD appeared to Abraham by his tent, and Abraham welcomed three men with a meal. The LORD said Sarah would have a son, and Sarah laughed.

key_moments.title: The Promised Son Is Born
key_moments.description: The LORD did as He had promised, and Sarah bore Abraham a son in his old age. Abraham was 100 years old, and he named the boy Isaac.

key_moments.title: The Test on Mount Moriah
key_moments.description: God tested Abraham by telling him to offer Isaac on a mountain in the land of Moriah. As Abraham took the knife, the angel of the LORD stopped him, and Abraham offered a ram caught by its horns in a bush instead.
